definitions.explanation: Natural variation between individual organisms, products, or specimens of the same type. Used for biological, medical, and product quality contexts.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}の{効|き}き{目|め}には{個体差|こたいさ}がある。
examples.english: There are individual differences in how well medicine works.

examples.japanese: {天然素材|てんねんそざい}のため、{色|いろ}や{模様|もよう}に{個体差|こたいさ}がございますのでご{了承|りょうしょう}ください。
examples.english: As this is made from natural materials, please understand that there may be individual differences in color and pattern.

notes:
Compound noun: {個体|こたい} (individual organism/specimen) + {差|さ} (difference). Commonly seen in product disclaimers for natural or handmade items, and in medical contexts regarding drug efficacy.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {個体差|こたいさ}がある (there is individual variation)
- {個体差|こたいさ}が{大|おお}きい (large individual variation)
- {個体差|こたいさ}を{考慮|こうりょ}する (to take individual differences into account)
